test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is not an environment function?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Accumulates waste.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **E****nvironment function:-**

 
 
• It refers to the **various roles or services** that the environment provides to** support life and human activities. **
 
• "Accumulates waste" is not an environment function.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sustains life:-

 
 
• It​ refers to the fundamental role of the environment in supporting and maintaining different forms of life on Earth. 
 
 
 
• Provides the supply of resources:-
 
 
• It​ highlights the critical role of the environment in providing essential resources such as water, air, food, fuel, and minerals to support human activities and development. 
 
 
 
• Enhances the quality of life:-
 
 
• It refers to the positive impact of a healthy and sustainable environment on human well-being, health, and social and economic development.
